description: Proves PMail did not collect conventional identity during an operation

judges.description: TRUE if all dependency identity surfaces have legal_identity_required=false, account_required=false
TRUE if no IDENTITY_BRIDGED providers are in the operation dependency chain

gates.description: Operation privacy class must be ANON_CORE

critical_rules: This claim is about PMail's own data collection, not provider behavior
A provider may collect identity externally; that degrades the provider's classification
But PMail itself must not require, store, or transmit conventional identity in ANON_CORE mode
Marketing 'no KYC' claims are metadata, not proof of actual field collection
Evidence must show the actual fields requested during the operation path
